verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's Computer docs describe a per-chat tool approval mode. In 'auto' mode nothing changes on disk and no command runs until the user approves, and pending actions appear as Allow/Deny tool cards. RBAC roles add a baseline trust layer for users. However, the core platform's Tools, Functions and Pipelines execute arbitrary Python directly on the server, with no documented isolation. missing for 10: container/VM sandboxing of tool or code execution, granular per-tool allow/deny policies, containment for server-side plugins, independent or hands-on corroboration of the approval modes.
